The results are in

The Target Coil platform delivers coil conformability, softness and volume in a single product family—and the Target Registry proves the effectiveness of Target Coils for the treatment of intracranial aneurysms. The investigator-initiated study demonstrated a low 2.4% retreatment rate and strong functional outcomes for the patient. Target Coils have been a trusted product for over a decade. And the evidence is a big reason why.

Primary endpoints:
Aneurysm packing density

Secondary endpoints:
Immediate and long-term aneurysm occlusion rate
(Raymond scale) and independent functional outcome (mRS)
